note: Budgets and seeds are frozen before any training command in this branch. Results must come from the raw JSONL logs; do not edit numbers after the run.

task.description: 1-D navigation on [0, 1]. Action 1 = +0.15, action 0 = -0.15. Episode ends at position > 0.7 or 25 steps. Reward +1 on success else -0.05 per step.

successCriterion: For a seed, mean return of the last 20 episodes is strictly greater than mean return of the first 20 episodes.
improvementTask: The same nav1d-discrete task. Report every seed (success and failure). No fabricated convergence.

eval.checkpoint: trained policy for that seed versus the same agent's untrained checkpoint, same greedy starts
